Final Project Submission Guidelines – 
Summer Internship 2026 
Students who have successfully completed all the internship objectives are requested to 
prepare their final technical report/documentation based on the work completed during the 
internship and submit it as soon as possible. 
Technical Report 
The report should clearly include the following sections: 
• 
Project Title 
• 
Objective and Problem Statement 
• 
Technologies/Tools Used 
• 
System Architecture and Design 
• 
Methodology/Implementation 
• 
Work Completed 
• 
Screenshots/Demo Outputs 
• 
Challenges Faced 
• 
Results and Outcomes 
• 
Future Scope and Next Development Plan 
• 
References (if any) 
Please ensure that the report is well-structured, technically sound, and free from grammatical 
and formatting errors. 
Source Code Submission 
Along with the report, submit the complete source code in a well-organized manner. The 
source code should include: 
• 
Proper folder structure 
• 
Well-documented and readable code 
• 
README.md containing project description, setup, and execution instructions 
• 
requirements.txt (or equivalent dependency file) 
• 
Configuration files (if applicable) 
• 
Sample input/output (if applicable) 
Submission Instructions 
Email: dilip.cse@nitjsr.ac.in 
Email Subject: 
<Your Name> - Summer Internship 2026 
Attachments: 
• 
Technical Report in DOC/DOCX or LaTeX source files
